messages:
taylor_newhire: Hi all — first week! Quick docs question: where should I keep my daily ramp notes in Notion vs things that should be official? Also who can give me edit rights to the onboarding templates? Thanks!
kim_devex: Welcome Taylor! Personal ramp notes -> Notion 'My Pages' (private). Official/team-facing docs live in Team Docs > Product > Onboarding and should go through the docs-review flow before becoming canonical. For template edits ping @olivia_docs.
olivia_docs: @taylor_newhire I can add you. Which template do you need: 'Engineer Ramp (personal copy)' or 'Onboarding Checklist (canonical)'? Note: canonical templates are locked to prevent drift and require a docs-approver sign-off.
taylor_newhire: personal copy for now. Also any naming convention so managers can find notes and we don't clutter the team space?
mike_manager: we use "Ramp — <First> <Last>" or "<First> Ramp [MMDD]" and set a page property Owner=<name> and tags #ramp #private. When something is useful company-wide, move it into Team Docs and open a docs-review PR.
olivia_docs: Invite sent to the Team Docs editors group. Heads up SSO/SCIM may take ~10 minutes to finish. If you need immediate one-off access, DM me the page link and I'll share it temporarily.
notion_bot: System: Notion invitation dispatched to taylor_newhire@redwood.com. SCIM sync status: pending.
taylor_newhire: perfect, thanks everyone! also where's the docs-review PR template?
kim_devex: Docs-review template lives in Team Docs > Process > Docs Review Template (link: https://notion.so/r/docs-review-template). Use that when promoting pages.
taylor_newhire: got it, appreciate the help!
